title: Humanoid Market 2026: an open dataset on shipments, valuations and disclosure (Physical AI, by the Numbers #1)
description: Source-cited dataset on the humanoid robot market: units shipped, financing rounds and valuations, revenue, sector venture funding, published forecasts, prices and costs, public evidence of robots doing useful work, line items quoted verbatim from company filings, a valuation-per-robot metric and a disclosure scorecard of what each humanoid maker discloses. Every value cites a public source; currency conversions use Federal Reserve H.10 rates. Data cut-off: 2026-10-12. Data under CC BY 4.0; code under MIT.
